description.raw:
## Report and reproduction
Technical acceptance resource for approved Task[Bug] mapping and Owner18 Native pipeline; isolated lifecycle fixtures already qualified.

## Expected/actual behavior
Expected: An exact human-approved Task1/NEW1 create with own Owner18 author, Native readback and RAG sync; all existing work packages preserved.
Actual: Native mutation not executed at proposal time. Later assignment/fix/retest/review/status changes require new concrete proposals and approvals.

## Severity and source evidence
Severity: low
CODEX_WF09_MAIN_QUALIFICATION_RESULT.json; CODEX_OWNER_NATIVE_E2E_DRIVER_BOUNDARY_RESULT.json
Evidence verification: NOT_VERIFIED_BY_SYSTEM

## Duplicate references
No lexical candidate in current visible snapshot; not proof of uniqueness.
Disposition: No candidate to disposition

## Fix tracking
Not submitted

## QA retest evidence
Not submitted; NOT_VERIFIED_BY_SYSTEM

## Review
Not submitted

## Proposed real application-defect binding (human-approved scope required)
Story: A PM converts a cited BA WBS into Native Epic/Task/Subtask nodes with explicit source dates and dependencies, without rewriting model business output or bypassing independent approvals.
Scope: QLDAPM Main WBS adapter and exact Native dated-parent verifier only. This maps the retained technical test Bug to the real defect reproduced during the approved BA run; no unrelated product feature or full application QA claim.
Analysis: Valid uppercase BA node keys failed Native key validation. After encoding, an actual Native clone stopped SOURCE_CHANGED because dated-child aggregation saved a parent twice and expanded parent data changed inside a child API response. The corrected code preserves raw BA output hash, verifies each own child receipt and exact model chain/calendar, and excludes expanded related resources from WP identity. Unknown children, unrelated model fields and excess versions remain held.
AC1: Application regression NativeWbsAnalysisTests.test_model_uppercase_keys_are_encoded_without_changing_business_graph_or_source preserves raw output hash, graph, requirements and scheduling; collisions and dangling references are rejected.
AC2: Application regression ScheduledParentEffectsTests.test_exact_native_two_save_first_child_and_later_child_chain verifies the dated-parent model chain using exact own child receipts and Native calendar evidence.
AC3: Application regressions ScheduledParentEffectsTests.test_business_edit_unknown_child_extra_version_and_bad_calendar_are_not_parent_effects and test_expanded_parent_changes_do_not_change_the_verified_work_package retain fail-closed source protection while allowing unrelated expanded-parent data to refresh.
AC4: Actual isolated Native qualification CODEX_WF10_MODEL_TO_NATIVE_FINAL_RESULT.json reaches VERIFIED_COMPLETED for four nodes, exact supplied dates and follows lag0, with current RAG citations and one create after lost acknowledgment. Simulated isolated decisions and synthetic embeddings are explicitly labelled; no Main business mutation or human QA decision is inferred.
Evidence scope: These are actual application-code and isolated Native results for this WBS defect. Existing accepted technical readback evidence for WP375 does not verify this Bug. Future fix/build/QA/retest/closure still requires an admitted producer, independent human reviews and separate exact Native transition approvals.
Code provenance: CODEX_WF10_FINAL_SCHEDULE_DEPLOYMENT_RESULT.json pins the deployed Gateway/Core/source hashes; raw BA output hash 4bcbbd93eeb110f99bab1b66846c814cda1af09ded78d2a18c209a63121a9ae7 remains unchanged. Preserve all prior technical qualification text above.
